summary: A member can choose local trim with [trim] local = true: it then takes no part in checkpoint agreement and adopts no peer's manifest, finishing only a trim it had already committed. Off by default

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. No claim family is trimmed locally yet.

compatibility.detail: No wire, stored format or claim kind change. A new optional [trim] config section; a default config does not write it. With local = true the member seals, verifies and adopts no checkpoint, and its adopt endpoint refuses with trim-is-local. Every participant must seal, so the other members' checkpoints stop until a person excuses it, as with [checkpoint] enabled = false.

downtime.detail: None. The setting is read at startup.

manual.detail: No manual step. Nothing changes unless a member opts in.

recovery.detail: Remove the setting and restart: the member takes part in checkpoints again and adopts the newest stable one from a peer as a returning node does.
